<document id="products-checks">
Checkbooks,ˆcashier'sˆchecksˆandˆmoneyˆordersˆTallowbrookˆdoesn'tˆofferˆpaperˆcheckbooks,ˆcashier'sˆchecksˆorˆmoneyˆorders.ˆ##ˆPayingˆsomeoneˆwhoˆneedsˆaˆcheckˆOptionsˆincludeˆBrookPayˆ(ifˆthey'reˆaˆTallowbrookˆmember),ˆanˆACHˆtransferˆtoˆtheirˆbankˆaccount,ˆorˆaˆwire.ˆManyˆlandlordsˆacceptˆACH.ˆ##ˆDepositingˆchecksˆYouˆcanˆdepositˆpaperˆchecksˆmadeˆoutˆtoˆyouˆbyˆtakingˆaˆphotoˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSeeˆ"Depositingˆaˆcheckˆinˆtheˆapp".ˆ##ˆMoneyˆordersˆWeˆcan'tˆissueˆmoneyˆorders,ˆandˆmoneyˆordersˆcan'tˆbeˆdepositedˆthroughˆtheˆapp.ˆ##ˆClosingˆbalanceˆchecksˆTheˆonlyˆtimeˆweˆmailˆaˆcheckˆisˆwhenˆyouˆcloseˆyourˆaccountˆwithoutˆaˆlinkedˆexternalˆaccount.ˆWeˆsendˆtheˆremainingˆbalanceˆbyˆcheck.ˆ##ˆDirectˆdepositˆformsˆthatˆaskˆforˆaˆvoidedˆcheckˆUseˆtheˆpre-filledˆdirectˆdepositˆformˆinˆtheˆappˆinstead.ˆItˆhasˆeverythingˆaˆvoidedˆcheckˆwouldˆshow.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="security-scams">
CommonˆscamsˆtoˆwatchˆforˆTheseˆareˆtheˆscamsˆweˆseeˆmostˆoften.ˆKnowingˆthemˆisˆtheˆbestˆprotection.ˆ##ˆFakeˆbankˆcallsˆSomeoneˆcallsˆclaimingˆtoˆbeˆfromˆTallowbrook'sˆfraudˆteam.ˆTheyˆknowˆsomeˆofˆyourˆdetailsˆandˆsayˆyourˆaccountˆisˆatˆrisk.ˆTheyˆaskˆforˆaˆcodeˆorˆaskˆyouˆtoˆmoveˆmoney.ˆThat'sˆaˆscam.ˆWeˆneverˆdoˆthat.ˆ##ˆImpersonatingˆsomeoneˆyouˆknowˆAˆmessageˆfromˆaˆ"familyˆmember"ˆwithˆaˆnewˆnumberˆwhoˆurgentlyˆneedsˆmoney.ˆCallˆthemˆonˆtheirˆoldˆnumberˆbeforeˆyouˆsendˆanything.ˆ##ˆMarketplaceˆandˆrentalˆscamsˆAˆsellerˆasksˆyouˆtoˆpayˆbyˆBrookPayˆorˆwireˆinsteadˆofˆaˆprotectedˆpaymentˆmethod,ˆoftenˆforˆaˆdealˆthatˆseemsˆtooˆgood.ˆBrookPayˆandˆwiresˆcan'tˆbeˆreversed.ˆ##ˆJobˆandˆinvestmentˆscamsˆSomeoneˆoffersˆeasyˆmoneyˆforˆmovingˆfundsˆthroughˆyourˆaccount,ˆorˆpromisesˆguaranteedˆreturns.ˆMovingˆmoneyˆforˆothersˆcanˆgetˆyourˆaccountˆclosed.ˆ##ˆWhatˆtoˆdoˆIfˆyouˆthinkˆyou'veˆbeenˆscammed,ˆmessageˆusˆstraightˆaway.ˆTheˆsoonerˆweˆknow,ˆtheˆbetterˆtheˆchanceˆofˆstoppingˆorˆrecoveringˆtheˆmoney,ˆalthoughˆweˆcan'tˆpromiseˆthat.ˆSeeˆ"Ifˆyouˆsentˆmoneyˆtoˆaˆscammer".ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="fee-refunds">
AskingˆforˆaˆfeeˆrefundˆSupportˆcanˆrefundˆsomeˆfees.ˆThereˆareˆtwoˆkindsˆofˆrefund.ˆ##ˆFeesˆchargedˆinˆerrorˆIfˆweˆchargedˆaˆfeeˆyourˆplanˆdoesn'tˆhave,ˆorˆchargedˆtheˆsameˆfeeˆtwice,ˆweˆrefundˆit.ˆThere'sˆnoˆlimitˆonˆtheseˆrefundsˆandˆtheyˆdon'tˆcountˆtowardˆanythingˆelse.ˆ##ˆGoodwillˆrefundsˆOnceˆinˆanyˆrollingˆ12-monthˆperiod,ˆsupportˆcanˆrefundˆoneˆfeeˆofˆupˆtoˆ$25.00ˆasˆaˆcourtesy,ˆevenˆifˆitˆwasˆchargedˆcorrectly.ˆThatˆcoversˆATMˆfees,ˆforeignˆtransactionˆfees,ˆcardˆreplacementˆandˆexpeditedˆshippingˆfees,ˆwireˆfeesˆandˆcashˆdepositˆfees.ˆPlanˆfeesˆaren'tˆeligibleˆforˆgoodwillˆrefunds.ˆTheyˆhaveˆtheirˆownˆcooling-offˆruleˆinstead.ˆ##ˆWhatˆsupportˆcan'tˆdoˆSupportˆcan'tˆrefundˆaˆsecondˆfeeˆasˆgoodwillˆwithinˆ12ˆmonths,ˆcan'tˆrefundˆaˆsingleˆfeeˆaboveˆ$25.00ˆasˆgoodwill,ˆandˆcan'tˆmakeˆexceptionsˆtoˆtheseˆrules.ˆIfˆyouˆthinkˆaˆfeeˆwasˆchargedˆinˆerror,ˆtellˆusˆwhyˆandˆwe'llˆcheck.ˆ##ˆHowˆtoˆaskˆOpenˆtheˆfeeˆinˆyourˆactivityˆfeed,ˆtapˆGetˆhelp,ˆandˆchooseˆQuestionˆaboutˆaˆfee.ˆRefundsˆshowˆupˆinˆyourˆbalanceˆrightˆaway.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
</documents>
